exact-direct-authorization97.md.content:
# New direct user authorization for the unchanged Phase97 batch

This is local authorization evidence outside all frozen model inputs. It does not change the payload, controller, endpoint or existing execution seal. The earlier two automatic-review rejection events remain preserved.

The direct user replied to the exact question describing S01 (enzyme/catalyst question, original full parent and 12 textbook blocks) and S02 (bacterial DNA replication question, original full parent and 11 blocks), plus extraction instructions, at `https://api.deepseek.com/v1/chat/completions`. The question named frozen `5703-checker97/bundle97.json`, at most one request per case, two total and CNY0.10, no retry, external processing, header-only authentication and no observed learner identity/history.

The received user answer was:

> 允许上述准确发送范围

Normal approval subsequently accepted the unchanged action. This resolves the external-scope approval blocker; it does not certify semantic quality or permit repeating an interrupted request. The first accepted process launch returned Windows initialization failure -1073741502; no claim/output existed at that check and a harmless same-Python startup check then passed. The subsequent accepted launch created exec session 73088, which terminated with 1073807364 and no returned stdout. The next exec-server read failed to reconnect. Later read-only recovery found one S01 financial claim and no response or settlement. The interrupted batch must not be restarted or treated as zero provider exposure.
